d: We are seeking a skilled and technically competent CNC Machinist / CNC Programmer to operate, programme, and maintain Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machines for precision manufacturing operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for interpreting engineering drawings, developing machining programmes, setting up machines, and producing high-quality components in accordance with technical specifications, production requirements, and quality standards.
Operate, programme, and set up CNC machines, including CNC milling, turning, and machining centres.
Develop, edit, and optimise CNC programmes using appropriate programming languages and software.
Interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and dimensional requirements.
Select and install appropriate cutting tools, fixtures, and machining equipment.
Perform machine setup, tool offsets, workpiece positioning, and calibration.
Monitor machining operations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and production efficiency.
Conduct dimensional inspections using precision measuring instruments such as vernier calipers, micrometers, and gauges.
Troubleshoot machining issues, programme errors, and equipment malfunctions.
Perform routine machine maintenance and ensure equipment operates efficiently.
Ensure finished components meet required tolerances, specifications, and quality standards.
Identify opportunities to improve machining processes, reduce material waste, and increase productivity.
Maintain accurate production records, machining programmes, and inspection reports.
Follow standard operating procedures and workplace health, safety, and environmental requirements.
Coordinate with production engineers, quality control teams, and manufacturing supervisors to meet production targets.
Diploma or technical qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Technology, CNC Machining, or a related discipline.
Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in CNC machining, machine operation, or CNC programming.
Strong knowledge of CNC milling, CNC turning, machining centres, and precision manufacturing processes.
Experience with CNC programming languages such as G-code and M-code.
Familiarity with CAD/CAM software such as Mastercam, SolidCAM, Fusion 360, or equivalent is preferred.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, technical specifications, and machining tolerances.
Good understanding of cutting tools, machining parameters, materials, and tooling selection.
Experience using precision measurement and inspection instruments.
Strong technical troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Good attention to detail and commitment to product quality.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a manufacturing team.
Willingness to work shifts or overtime when required.
Good command of written and spoken English.

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
